purpose: Living shared calendar for Marion, Dominic and their couple; generated automatically by MonIA from story, professional calendar, social circle, invitations and world events.

invitationFlow.onReceipt: MonIA checks Marion, Dominic and Couple calendars before surfacing contextual response choices.
invitationFlow.conflicts: Never silently accept. Surface availability/conflict and plausible options in gameplay.

autonomy.dominicSchedule: Dominic's professional and personal commitments are generated/updated by the world director and remain autonomous.
autonomy.gameplay: Relevant upcoming events surface automatically in ordinary gameplay; opening Agenda is optional.

researchRule: Use researched taurine/social context as a plausibility library, but never invent a real historical appearance by Dominic unless supported by canon or evidence.
visibility: Future commitments may be visible when Marion plausibly knows them; hidden surprises stay outside the calendar until revealed.
